For the sales rep

Built for the work between the truck and the front door.

Every house starts with a pin. The homeowner, roof details, claim, photos, follow-up and commission all live on that pin, so nothing gets lost between the first knock and the final check.

Satellite canvassing

Current, high-resolution satellite imagery. Pin the house you're standing at with one tap, or press and hold on any roof. Each status has its own icon, so a whole street reads at a glance.

Leads & follow-ups

Every door becomes a lead. Schedule a follow-up in one tap and get a reminder when it's due.

Inspection photos

Organize photos by slope and mark hail and wind damage directly on the image. Photos stay with the lead — not buried in your camera roll.

Inspection reports

Generate a polished PDF report with photos and storm details, ready for the homeowner or the adjuster.

Storm tracking

National Weather Service hail and wind reports, plotted on the map with sizes, dates and active alerts.

Route planning

Build an optimized route to the houses you choose and send it to Apple Maps or Google Maps in one tap.

Simple by design

Clean screens, clear statuses and nothing extra. The tools you need are close at hand, and out of the way until you need them.

Roofing tools

A pitch gauge that uses your phone's sensors, a hail size reference and a squares calculator.

Commission tracking

See what you've earned, what's owed and what's pending, measured against your monthly goal.

Track doors, appointments, closes and volume by day, week and month. Sales and milestones are shared with the team automatically.

Choose the houses to revisit — by status, street or follow-up date — and RidgeMate builds the most efficient driving order.

Roles and permissions

Owner, manager, rep and office roles, so everyone sees exactly what their job requires.

Territories and skip zones

Assign territories to reps and mark areas to avoid, such as new roofs and no-soliciting neighborhoods.

Easy onboarding

Import existing leads from a spreadsheet or another app, and invite your team in minutes.

Why RidgeMate

“I'm not a tech company. I'm a roofing project manager in Lancaster, South Carolina, and I built RidgeMate because our crew needed it.

We were knocking with one app, shooting photos with another, building reports in a third, and texting the office for everything else. Leads slipped. Follow-ups got missed. Two of us would knock the same door a day apart, and the homeowner would let us know about it.

So I put it all on the pin: the door, the homeowner, the photos, the follow-up, the commission. It takes the guessing out of it. No more texting the group “has anyone been to this area?” Open the map and you'll see every door your team has hit.

And the paperwork does itself. Shoot your photos on the roof, and by the time your feet hit the ground, there's a premium inspection report ready to hand the homeowner or send the adjuster. No more nights at the kitchen table building reports.

When you email support, you get me, not a call center. Tell me what's broken or what you need, and I'll build it.”

— Thad Jacobs, founder
FAQ

Common questions

Do I need to download RidgeMate from the App Store?

No. Open RidgeMate in Safari on iPhone and iPad, or Chrome on Android and desktop, then choose “Add to Home Screen.” It opens full-screen with its own icon, just like an app from the store.

Does it work on Android?

Yes. RidgeMate works on Android phones and tablets, as well as iPhone, iPad, Mac and Windows.

How does the free trial work?

Create an account and use every feature free for 14 days. No credit card is required to start. After the trial, plans are billed month to month with no contract.

Can reps see each other's leads?

Reps see their own leads and the Open Leads board. The shared map shows which houses the team has already visited, while homeowner details stay with the rep who owns the lead. Owners, managers and office staff can see all company leads.

Can I import leads from another app?

Yes. Export your leads as a spreadsheet (CSV) and RidgeMate will match the columns, place each address on the map, and let you assign leads to reps or post them to the board.

What happens when a rep leaves the company?

Their open leads return to the Open Leads board with photos, notes and history intact. Sold jobs remain with the company.

Where does the storm data come from?

Hail and wind reports come from the National Weather Service. They reflect reported storm activity, not confirmed damage to a specific roof, so an inspection is always recommended.

Who owns the data?

You do. You can export your data at any time, and account owners can delete their company account from Settings. See our privacy policy for details.
